# EduCourse

> South Africa's free online learning platform offering certificate courses in Microsoft Office, digital skills, and professional development with flexible, self-paced learning.

EduCourse connects South African learners with accessible online education and career opportunities. The platform specializes in practical Microsoft Office training, digital literacy, and professional skill development, serving both job seekers and employers across the country.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Office Suite

## Microsoft Office Certification Courses

- [Microsoft Word Basics](https://www.educourse.co.za/courses/microsoft-word-basic-course): Microsoft Word certificate course: document formatting and business writing
- [Microsoft Excel Certificate Course](https://www.educourse.co.za/courses/microsoft-excel-basic-course): Microsoft Excel certificate course: spreadsheet skills and data management
- [Microsoft PowerPoint Course](https://www.educourse.co.za/courses/microsoft-powerpoint-basics): Microsoft PowerPoint certificate course: presentation design and slide skills
- [Microsoft Outlook Course](https://www.educourse.co.za/courses/microsoft-outlook-course): Microsoft Outlook certificate course: email management and productivity tools
